interest: Indexes 1940-42 global tracking of Japanese naval movements, especially the transport Asaka Maru's diplomatic voyage to Portugal via Panama.
overview: This file comprises the U.S. State Department's decimal file 894.33 (File 179) docket sheets, designated 'List of Papers' (Form DS-46), recording communications, intelligence reports, and cross-references regarding the movements of Japanese naval vessels and foreign naval visits between May 1940 and June 1942. The compiled entries track the strategic deployment and reconnaissance of the Imperial Japanese Navy across the Pacific, Southeast Asia, and globally leading up to and during World War II. A major focus of the papers concerns the voyage of the Japanese armed naval transport Asaka (Asaka Maru) en route to Lisbon via the Panama Canal, including diplomatic negotiations over U.S. security inspections, transit conditions, British naval blockade restrictions on Axis goods, and the transport of Japanese military officials to Berlin. Additional intelligence entries document Japanese submarine movements near Hainan, the Philippines, the Red Sea, and Peru; naval and air buildups in French Indochina (Saigon, Cam Ranh Bay), Thailand, and Bias Bay; fleet concentrations off Japan and the Pacific Mandates; and Axis maritime coordination.

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 15 through 21 concerning Japanese naval movements and early transit plans for the naval transport Asaka.
subfiles.summary: Lists 1940-41 items: Japanese fleet movements near Palau, submarines at Hainan, and early notice of the armed transport Asaka's voyage.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 1 (Revised October 17, 1945)

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 15 through 21 on Japanese naval forces and the transport Asaka.
subfiles.summary: Lists earlier 1940-41 items: Japanese moves toward Palau and Indochina, Hainan submarines, and Japan's Canal-transit request for the Asaka.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 1 (October 12, 1945)

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 22 through 29 regarding Panama Canal transit arrangements for the Asaka and naval movements near Thailand.
subfiles.summary: Lists Jan-Feb 1941 items: the armed Asaka's Panama Canal transit dispute, resolved by placing liaison officers aboard.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 3

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 30 through 34 on Japanese naval movements in Southeast Asia and Canal courtesies for the Asaka.
subfiles.summary: Lists Feb 1941 items: Matsuoka's thanks for the Asaka's Canal passage, and Japanese fleet moves into the Gulf of Siam.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 4

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 35 through 43 on Japanese naval activities in Thailand, Hong Kong waters, and the Asaka's arrival in Europe.
subfiles.summary: Lists Feb 1941 items: Japanese destroyer visits in Siam, and the Asaka's arrival at Lisbon with 111 officials.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 5

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 44 through 54 regarding British blockade scrutiny of the Asaka Maru and warship movements in Saigon.
subfiles.summary: Lists Feb-Mar 1941 items: British blockade warnings on the Asaka Maru's cargo, and a destroyer swap at Saigon.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 6

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 55 through 60 regarding legal aspects of the British blockade, Japanese withdrawal from Saigon, and maritime intelligence.
subfiles.summary: Lists Feb-Apr 1941 items: British interception of the Asaka Maru's Portuguese cargo, and the Japanese pullback of bombers from Saigon.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 7

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entries 61 through 71 concerning worldwide Japanese naval movements, aircraft deployments, and submarine sightings.
subfiles.summary: Lists Mar 1941-Jan 1942 items: global Japanese naval intelligence, including fleet concentration and submarines near the Red Sea and Peru.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 8

subfiles.about: State Department docket sheet logging entry 72 regarding Spanish press statements on Axis submarine fueling.
subfiles.summary: Lists a June 1941 Spain telegram: officials denied Spanish ships fueled Axis submarines, to American, British, French, and Japanese press.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet 9
